notes: The single *and* of τε καί is given to καί, leaving the first τε unrepresented on rule 70's English-side test; giving it to τε instead remains defensible and is noted.
The second τε has no answering καί and takes its own *and*.
σκεῦος ἐκλογῆς → *a chosen vessel*: both terms anarthrous, so the supplied determiner belongs to the noun (rule 58).
ἐνώπιον is rendered by a single English word, so rule 71's frame question does not arise.
